confirmedCodeDefects.before: createMapTransition catch left busy=true forever. Even a later successful loadCharacter retry could not resume because syncPlayback returned immediately while busy.
confirmedCodeDefects.fix: Clear busy in finally, retain failed latch and reject automatic travel while failed. Only a fully successful explicit loadCharacter reload invokes recover. Playback and audio remain paused while failed, including errors in finish after destination music selection.
confirmedCodeDefects.regression: Actual main prepare/release/load/finish/onError, loadCharacter, retry button DOM and FrameLoop: release, download or finish failure stays covered/paused; closing settings or foreground return does not resume partial world; explicit reload then return travel succeeds; hidden reload stays paused until foreground.

confirmedCodeDefects.before: releaseEnvironment waits for high-texture pendingTask, but disposing VillageTextureStreaming did not settle a Texture callback promise if its loader never completed. This could leave release waiting indefinitely.
confirmedCodeDefects.fix: Track each owned high-texture callback waiter and reject it immediately with AbortError on map disposal. Late load/error callbacks cannot reassign the material. Own a Texture wrapper before updateURL starts I/O so synchronous request exceptions can clean it up.
confirmedCodeDefects.regression: Actual Babylon Texture construction with deliberately withheld backend completion, late callbacks, synchronous request exception and fresh map material ownership.

confirmedCodeDefects.before: Pinned Babylon9.31 AbstractEngine.addPendingData stores an InternalTexture. BaseTexture.dispose removes the wrapper only; a callback that never completes can leave the internal token in scene readiness even after the wrapper is gone.
confirmedCodeDefects.fix: On cancellation/error, remove only the exact owned InternalTexture token when its last reference is about to be disposed. Keep the token if another live Texture still owns the shared internal allocation. Never clear global pendingData.
confirmedCodeDefects.regression: Inject the same internal pending token in the fixture; actual environment release completes with no texture callback, waiting-items0 and references0. After actual map replacement, scene.isReady and waitForSceneReady succeed. Shared internal references2 preserve their other owner's pending token until real completion.
